biggest_catch: Task availability is not guaranteed and the platform publishes no per-task time — good tasks get claimed quickly, and your effective hourly pay depends entirely on task speed, so $3–$7 per task can translate to very low hourly earnings.
catches: Task availability not guaranteed; good tasks get taken quickly — idle/claimless time earns nothing.
Platform does not publish per-task duration; task-length estimates (~15–20 min) come from assistant reports, not official terms.
Effective hourly rate depends on task speed; complex tasks may take longer than the $3–$7 pays for.
Application review can take time and may require multiple attempts to pass.
